A note from my heart

Just for you

Dear Mansi,

Tumhari masoomiyat mein kuch aisa hai jo mere dil ko bahut sukoon deta hai. Kabhi-kabhi samajh hi nahi aata ki tumhe kaise bataun ki tum mere liye kitni special ho.

Main bas tumhe bahut saara pyaar dena chahta hoon, aisa pyaar jisme tum hamesha khud ko safe, respected aur khush mehsoos karo. Tumhari muskurahat bani rahe, tumhare sapne poore hon, aur tum kabhi apni ye pyaari si masoomiyat mat khona.

Mujhe har baar perfect words nahi milenge, par meri feelings sachchi hain. Happy Birthday, Mansi. ❤️

Hamesha tumhara, Govind ♡
